description: §21.3 / §21.4 — m.scrml has `export * from './missing2.scrml'`, which does not exist: E-IMPORT-006 at the star re-export, naming the missing file. The importer's `import { M2 } from './m.scrml'` (a name only the missing module could supply) is not reported as E-IMPORT-004.
rationale: §21.3: a relative import must resolve to a real module (E-IMPORT-006). `export * from` links its source like an import (§21.4). Before S458 the missing star source surfaced only as an E-IMPORT-004 at the importer, which named the wrong file and the wrong cause (S458 re-review N1).
